candidates.title: Basilisk: Kouga Ninpou Chou
candidates.reason: Across the complete 24-episode 2005 anime, a Tokugawa succession contest forces ten elite ninja from each of the rival Kouga and Iga clans into a lethal struggle. Their distinctive, often grotesque supernatural techniques drive frequent ambushes, disguise, tactical counters and bloody fights; the concealed contest terms, political manipulation and Tenzen's unusual survival ability add suspense and revelations. The story is bleak and cruel, with intense combat, repeated deaths and striking stylized character designs. Limitations: it is a tragic clan-war romance and character drama as much as a supernatural action series; the lead pair's relationship is central. Abilities are diverse but have little systematic explanation, training or progressive growth. Psychological maneuvering tends to be situational rather than sustained mind games, and reviews disagree about fight choreography, pacing, characterization and dated animation. The series also includes disturbing sexual violence. Evidence covers the 2005 24-episode adaptation, not the 2018 sequel or live-action film.
